WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, fulfilment_type,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, w.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales, 'sale' AS kind
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, w.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net, 'ret_web'
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
  JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind='sale' THEN net_sales END) gross_web,
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind='sale' AND fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN net_sales END) gross_cc,
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind='ret_web' THEN net_sales END) ret_web,
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind='ret_web' AND fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN net_sales END) ret_cc,
  SUM(net_sales) net_web,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN net_sales END) net_cc,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN net_sales END)/SUM(net_sales),2) share_net,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN kind='sale' AND fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN net_sales END)/SUM(CASE WHEN kind='sale' THEN net_sales END),2) share_before_returns
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (6,7,8)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(x.v) net, SUM(x.b) before_ret FROM (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date bd, f.net_amount v, f.net_amount b FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net, 0 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test') x
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=x.bd WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (6,7,8) GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(net_sales) net, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) before_ret, SUM(returns_net) ret
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (6,7,8) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.fiscal_period, m.net mine_net, c.net ctl_net, m.before_ret mine_before, c.before_ret ctl_before, c.ret ctl_ret FROM mine m JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_period) ORDER BY 1
